description: Open-web searches covered general country/month terms in English and Spanish, French and Portuguese equivalents, four weekly January windows, student and labor leads, official sources and retrospective reporting. Search engines returned many older and unrelated pages. This is bounded open-web discovery, not exhaustive media coverage or proof that no protest occurred.
required_followup: Coordinator review and any available archival/news database research; do not convert an open-web non-hit into a claim that no event occurred.

description: The January 13 UNGE notice concerns thesis-work incentives, while related student pages describe possible mobilization at unspecified or older dates. No verified in-period physical assembly, start date, location, state-policy demand, organization or 50-person threshold is available for January 2023.
required_followup: If source access becomes available under a fresh open-window receipt and manual scope review, read the exact article pages and check contemporary reports for an actually held gathering.

description: The 2014-era youth-organization and older UNGE mobilization leads are separate historical records. They must not be merged with the 2017–18 student-stipend threat or treated as January 2023 events.

description: A SOMAGEC worker-protest result names Malabo and Bata but its saved native header has no publication date; the article body was not requested. Its relation to January 2023, physical episode boundaries, participants and state response are unknown.

description: S016 and S017 each had an exact-URL web.open failure (cache miss or 502) and an ordinary HTTPS attempt that failed during DNS before HTTP. No article text was received, and no access denial was established. Receipts and complete manual-scope reports are retained under access_receipts/. The source window is now closed, so no additional body attempts were made.
required_followup: Only retry if the coordinator reopens the body window and a fresh receipt plus full manual source-ledger, alias and written-origin review permits the exact URL.

description: One December 2022 query and the January searches did not establish a continuing protest episode; a February 2023 query also did not establish a linked follow-on episode. Continuity is unresolved because open-web date indexing is noisy and no article bodies were read.
required_followup: Recheck adjacent months in accessible contemporary archives before assigning any continuation or episode boundary.

description: The searches used Spanish, English, French and Portuguese terms, but did not provide systematic access to local press archives or reporting in every locally used language. There was no LexisNexis-equivalent search.
required_followup: Keep language, archive and database coverage limits in view during coordinator review; do not claim exhaustiveness.
